what: owner review after the A3 execution and S12: compressor, S1a, capability demonstration, traceability, O4 dispositions, project conclusion
project_conclusion: Simulation work has reached decision adequacy and does not identify a validated Hall transport candidate. The credible Hall set remains empty. Architecture selection must now come primarily from the controlled H-1 hardware experiment.

decisions.DI_1_4_compressor_C1: Keep C1 (bladed turbomolecular first stage) as the leading conditional candidate: status LEADING_CANDIDATE_PENDING_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE. DI-1.4 is NOT frozen until the Li 2015 compression claim is verified from a first-hand source; a secondary citation is not enough for a system-critical compressor choice.
decisions.compressor_power_allocation: 300 W approved as a design/screening allocation, NOT a hard physical elimination gate. The hard gate remains full-system P_bus < 1.5 kW: a compressor needing more than 300 W is not rejected if the overall system closes below 1.5 kW.
decisions.backflow_b: b = 0.25 approved as the nominal conservative screening assumption; backflow stays an uncertainty/sensitivity parameter until experimentally or design-credibly established; never called a measured flight value.
decisions.S1a_verdicts: only S1A_READY / S1A_NOT_READY; no intermediate verdict; the report may list partial precursors, the gate stays binary and fail-closed.
decisions.C1_diode_in_S1a: allowed, provided Hall discharge is physically inhibited; data class NON_SCORE_BEARING_ENGINEERING_ONLY. C-1 heater/keeper/emission/diode behaviour may be commissioned; no H-1 thrust, Hall I_d, knee, extinction, T_e/n_e, species, divergence or other W5 held-out observable may be exposed.
decisions.registration_input_released_before_LOCK_: freeze the exact released input and its hash as registration/calibration evidence; it can never later be treated as held-out. If anything originally intended as held-out is exposed, permanently mark that condition OUTPUTS_SEEN / not held-out and update the pre-registration BEFORE any score-bearing H-1 data. Never reclassify afterwards.
decisions.S1a_interlock_limits: limits come from real hardware/facility ratings, not invented thresholds
decisions.capability_demo_thresholds: keep the existing planning thresholds; do not loosen them; the capability demonstration discovers whether hardware meets them; if not, LOCK-2 / experiment design changes before score-bearing data
decisions.S1_C4_categories: do not reduce the nine-category score-bearing gate; stage them: S1a establishes the six no-plasma/calibration-capable categories; S1b / Hall-on qualification supplies pressure-under-operation, oscillation spectra and species/divergence capability
decisions.force_DC_RF_traceability: SI-traceable calibration through an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited scope appropriate to the measurement; no invented 'class' where the standard defines none; calibration certificate, uncertainty budget, traceability chain and raw calibration record mandatory
decisions.metrology_specification: approved as the procurement specification now (authorizes quotes / lab capability); it does NOT constitute a demonstrated measurement capability
decisions.HW_C1_09: confirmed as written (tube thermocouple mandatory; pyrometer where optical access permits; tube temperature never reported as emitter temperature)
decisions.A3_in_N4: keep A3 as fail-closed authority; do not weaken N4
decisions.MFC_ranges: 0.030-3.14 mg/s is ~106:1 turndown; at least three overlapping ranges per gas path become part of procurement planning
decisions.intake_sizing: the molecular-entrance constraint (0.098-0.377 m2 minimum inlet at b = 0.25, ~1.6-1.7x the earlier estimate) makes intake/compressor sizing a spacecraft-level driver before the flight geometry is locked

O4_dispositions.common_disposition: Retain as sensitivity evidence only; material sensitivity and/or domain-boundary movement; no new predictive evidence for transport admission; no promotion, no retuning, no threshold change, P5-N2 v1 stays INCONCLUSIVE permanently
O4_dispositions.caution_clause: families with counterfactual candidate-level FAIL_VALIDATION (Johnson-low, rot-off, HMS-high, N2 dication) increase caution around the affected candidates but validate no other candidate

decisions.deferred: sgb-screen-09 forensics and OOD-boundary forensics stay deferred; facility attempt 2 continues, non-gating

critical_path: primary compressor evidence + H-1 manufacture/configuration + facility + instrument procurement/calibration
S1a -> LOCK-1 -> W5 freeze -> S1/S1b -> LOCK-2
Phase 1 -> Phase 2 Hall/RF/ECR -> Phase 3 absolute thrust
